description: Deliberate survivors of the memory-surface residue sweep. Every row exempts a path prefix (plain startsWith) or a glob from the live count and must say why in plain words. Exemptions win over the structural historical rule, so an explicit row stays visible as an explicit row. The rule for adding one: exempt a file that is itself deleted or is pure narrative, never a file that survives the decommission — hiding a whole live config to silence one registration line would let real residue in behind it.
